instruction: Look at task-001_initial.scad in OpenSCAD. Change the irregular polygon base into a volume-preserving proportion study: set x_scale=1.25 and y_scale=0.80 on the provided footprint, set total_height=8.12 mm, and add a 1.5 mm top chamfer by tapering the top bevel section to 92% of the scaled footprint. Keep the finished solid centered at the origin. Save as STL named /home/user/Desktop/task-001_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
